notes.title: Release v1.0.4
notes.content: [h2]Enhancements[/h2][list][*][p]Made two achievements related to submitting incorrect solutions easier to obtain.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where players who transferred their save data over from the demo were unable to obtain some achievements.[/p][list][*][p]If you’ve met the requirements for these achievements, you should receive them upon entering the main menu.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed some instruments playing in the Powerplant song when they shouldn’t.[/p][/*][/list]

tags.balance_change: Made two achievements related to submitting incorrect solutions easier to obtain.

tags.bug: Fixed an issue where players who transferred their save data over from the demo were unable to obtain some achievements.
Fixed some instruments playing in the Powerplant song when they shouldn’t.

notes.title: Release v1.0.3
notes.content: [h2]Enhancements[/h2][list][*][p]Enabled V-Sync to fix screen tearing. (This forces the frame rate to be the highest-supported by your monitor, so the FPS Mode toggle in the System Settings has been removed.)[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the default keyboard bindings for the Reset Grid input action to include the R key.[/p][list][*][p]If you’ve used a previous version, press the [b]Reset Keyboard Configuration[/b] button in the Controls Settings to get this change.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Improved the way the game handles switching or disconnecting controllers while in the middle of input rebinding.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Bugfixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where submitting an incorrect solution directly after a correct one could cause the incorrect solution to be shown as correct.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some visuals issues that occurred if you made certain inputs extremely quickly after a correct solution was displayed.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed being able to leave the Controls Settings or select elements with the mouse while in the middle of input rebinding.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual issue with the back button when trying to leave the Controls Settings while a required input binding is missing.   [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a visual issue with the balloons in Suburbs.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][/h2][p][/p][p][/p]

tags.bug: Fixed a bug where submitting an incorrect solution directly after a correct one could cause the incorrect solution to be shown as correct.
Fixed some visuals issues that occurred if you made certain inputs extremely quickly after a correct solution was displayed.
Fixed being able to leave the Controls Settings or select elements with the mouse while in the middle of input rebinding.
Fixed a visual issue with the back button when trying to leave the Controls Settings while a required input binding is missing.
Fixed a visual issue with the balloons in Suburbs.

notes.title: Updated Demo Live for Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
notes.content:
We just released an updated demo for the [b]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/b]! Thanks to the feedback, we've improved the flow of the puzzles, updated some of the art and effects, and added a few more quality of life improvements.

Additionally, we've added localization for 13 additional languages:
[list]
[*] French
[*] Italian
[*] German
[*] Spanish - Spain
[*] Dutch
[*] Korean
[*] Polish
[*] Portuguese - Brazil
[*] Russian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[*] Traditional Chinese
[*] Vietnamese
[*] Japanese
[/list]
We're happy to be part of the Cerebral Puzzle Showcase again and want to thank them for such a wonderful gathering of games.

Let us know what you think of the updates and tell your friends to check it out!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215232/be9dc190372a149bc63ddc7cd0a8133e152e7820.gif[/img]

notes.title: Join us at the Thinky Direct and Cerebral Puzzle Showcase!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that we’ve joined Thinky Games and Draknek & Friends in two great events:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215232/2d8b43e771d9a784d7778eebf4264b9513b94171.png[/img]
[h1]Thinky Direct[/h1]
Tune into the very first [b]Thinky Direct[/b] on [b]May 29th[/b] at [b]6pm BST / 10am PDT / 1pm EDT[/b]! Hosted by Thinky Games on [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=iXyyhQdlx-M]Youtube[/url] and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/thinkygames]Twitch[/url], this showcase features announcements, news, and exclusive trailers for upcoming puzzle games. This also kicks off the [b]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/b] and is a must-watch for anyone who enjoys the games that scratches that part of your brain.

Keep an eye out for some CIPHER ZERO news during the direct!

[previewyoutube=iXyyhQdlx-M;full][/previewyoutube]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215232/6630787ce9ebda7340112839527c56ca443ebd36.png[/img]
[h1]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/h1]
From [b]May 29th to June 5th[/b], come celebrate the best puzzle games on Steam with the [b]Cerebral Puzzle Showcase[/b]! Complete with demos, new releases, and special discounts, discover that next brain-scratcher you've been looking for. 

[b]CIPHER ZERO[/b] returns with an updated demo for the showcase, including adjustments to puzzles, new art and effects, and quality of life improvements, as well as additional localization. The updated demo will be available when the showcase starts at [b]1pm EDT on May 29th.[/b]

Don't forget to share with others what you've tried and make sure to wishlist the ones you’re looking forward to. Here's to seeing what everyone is playing! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44215232/be9dc190372a149bc63ddc7cd0a8133e152e7820.gif[/img]
